Genuine, friendly and fun!
Mar 2024 • Friends
We came here almost by accident, looking for somewhere to stay for s couple of hours waiting for our train on a rainy Wednesday night. We were met by the owner with great warmth and hospitality. He speaks English well, and has some great local Craft ales that we sampled!

Wednesday evening was also their band practice night, and so we also had a surprise live band just for us! A serious band with two talented female singers that performed some great songs - we just wish we were her on a weekend with everyone else and the full performance too!

To end our evening, instead of kicking us out at closing time, he offered us to stay until our train at midnight. What a lovely man. 

If you're looking for a bar with good music, good beer and good people, you've found it!
